title: Machine identity policy and automated templates for service accounts
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Define, implement, and rollout a machine-identity (service account) creation policy and a set of automated least-privilege templates tied to RBAC v2 and audit logging requirements. This ticket covers the policy, template catalog, provisioning API changes, owner assignment model, and audit fields required for compliance and SSO/SAML alignment.
background: We currently have ad-hoc service account provisioning and several gaps identified during the recent internal audit: inconsistent owner fields, missing least-privilege patterns, and inadequate audit metadata for long-lived credentials. RBAC v2 introduces role scoping that we must reflect in templates and provisioning APIs. This work complements ENG-15840 (provisioning guardrails) but focuses on machine identity schemas, template automation, and owner delegation via SSO groups.
scope: In-scope: policy doc, template catalog (JSON/YAML templates) for common automation roles, provisioning API changes to enforce templates, UI/CLI changes for approving/assigning owners, audit log schema additions (owner_id, template_id, rotation_policy_id), migration tool for existing accounts. Out-of-scope: full RBAC v2 runtime enforcement, which is tracked separately.
acceptance_criteria: Policy doc approved by Security and Legal: outlines creation rules, allowed template list, owner delegation model, rotation SLA
Template catalog published with at least 8 templates covering CI runners, DB access, metric exporters, deployment agents, and monitoring integrations
Provisioning API refuses free-form roles when template enforcement flag is on and returns clear validation errors
Owner field can be a human principal (SSO user) or an SSO group; provisioning records must store owner_id and owner_type in audit logs
Audit log entries for create/update/delete of service accounts include template_id, requesting_principal, request_trace_id, and rotation_policy_id
Migration plan and script that tags existing accounts with best-effort template matches and flags ambiguous cases for manual review
Security review completed and signed off; unit and integration tests covering template validation and audit events present in CI
implementation_notes: Add /api/v1/service-accounts/templates endpoint to list and validate templates (read-only for non-admins)
Provisioning flow: request -> evaluate allowed templates -> if single match auto-assign -> if multiple require explicit template or approval -> create account with template_id and owner metadata
Owner assignment: prefer SAML group mapping to Redwood groups; for human owners require SSO verification (email + SCIM id) to avoid orphaned owners
Rotation: each template includes a default rotation_policy_id; provisioning records must surface rotation deadlines in Console
Audit fields: extend existing audit schema with template_id, owner_type, owner_id, requester_saml_assertion_id, request_trace_id
RBAC mapping: templates reference RBAC v2 roles by stable role_id; templates should be validated against current role registry at creation time
Backward compatibility: existing SA create endpoints accept legacy flag but must emit deprecation warnings and be blocked by enforcement toggle in org settings
rollout_plan: Week 1: finalize policy doc and template definitions; get Security/Legal comments
Week 2: implement template endpoints and provisioning validation; unit tests
Week 3: add audit schema changes and Console visibility for owner/template fields; internal dogfood on staging
Week 4: migration script run on staging; run manual reviews for ambiguous mappings
Week 5: enable enforcement toggle for a pilot org and monitor audit logs and support tickets
Week 6: gather pilot feedback, iterate, enable org-level enforcement flag broadly
Post-rollout: remove legacy create flow after 90 days with customer notifications
test_plan: Unit tests for template validation including invalid role references and forbidden permission sets
Integration tests exercising provisioning flow with SAML-mapped owner groups
Audit ingestion test asserting presence and correctness of template_id, requester_saml_assertion_id, owner_id
Migration script dry-run with reporting of ambiguous accounts and false positives
Load test for templates endpoint to ensure latency < 50ms at P95 under 1000 RPS (cached)
Manual QA: console owner assignment UI, approval flows, and admin override behavior
